title: Bank-to-campus grounds
caption: Connected planting beds, bank foundation drainage and a clear street edge, with matching map outlines. Earlier attempts are included below.

sections.title: Bank and campus grounds
sections.caption: Final views at desktop, phone and wide desktop sizes, with morning and evening lighting. Route views use the real crossing in both directions; foundation close-ups use diagnostic cameras. The wider southern lawns and existing pavement planting still need work.

sections.title: Before this pass
sections.caption: Matched views before the grounds changes, including the route across the boundary.

sections.title: Attempt 1
sections.caption: Rejected: repeated cover shapes and angular bed corners.

sections.title: Attempt 2
sections.caption: Rejected: lower cover still formed tiled rows.

sections.title: Attempt 3
sections.caption: Rejected: rows were gone, but the individual shapes still looked like flat discs.

sections.title: Attempt 4
sections.caption: Rejected: continuous cover produced long triangular facets.

sections.title: Attempt 5
sections.caption: The faceted shrub kit restored volume and clear gaps around trees and the lamp. Final views above include the subsequent drain correction.

sections.title: Capture diagnostics: wide view
sections.caption: Rejected capture setup: the test driver moved the player before the shot. These images do not establish a gameplay defect.

sections.title: Capture diagnostics: first route attempt
sections.caption: Retained displaced-camera captures. Some initial files were overwritten during a failed housekeeping step; the evidence report records that gap.

sections.title: Capture diagnostics: second route attempt
sections.caption: Retained route captures before the test driver was reliably held. The final route views above use the corrected capture setup.
